## Checklist
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the logic I changed
- [ ] `TODO(T..)` comments updated or removed
- [ ] No tokens, keys, or personal content in logs, responses, AI payloads, or fixtures
- [ ] Touches safety-critical code (`db/policies`, `server/changes`, `server/connections`, `server/proposals`, `server/runs`, AI payload/validation)? If yes: the other person has reviewed
- [ ] Changes a locked decision or adds a new service/table/endpoint? If yes: both agreed and the TDD is updated
